property_summary: For any caller that is the admin, calling setOwner(_owner) results in c.owner() == _owner in the reference; the mutant that assigns tx.origin instead can produce c.owner() != _owner when the admin's call is proxied through a forwarder (so tx.origin differs), which the fuzzer can find by providing a proxying forwarder address and admin input.
change_summary: Change setOwner to assign owner to tx.origin instead of the provided _owner, causing a different owner value after the call.
